changelog: Resource busy lock: while an operator runs a heavy job (bank-statement anomaly check / excerpt repair, or an in-app update), other users and other browser tabs see a pause message with that person’s name until the job…
Bank-statement “check all statements”: if a full audit finished less than an hour ago, the operator can reopen those results instead of re-running OCR on every PDF.
Bank-statement verify: bulk “fix all dates / amounts” with confirm, count and ETA; ledger-only rows without a covering archived statement are listed as ignored (not actionable).
Session idle timeout no longer logs anyone out in the middle of a heavy job (statement audit, excerpt repair, in-app update): the holder’s session stays alive until the job ends.
Resource-busy pause shows the operation name first and “Started by … at …”, and hard-unlocks the instance after at most 30 minutes.
Documents: Estratti Conto list newest reference period first (year, then month).
Document repository: `annotate()` can update `original_name` so downloads match the archive title.

Treasury movement edit: statement excerpt opens in a zoomable popup (same UX as statement verify) and the on-form preview is twice as large; open ledger anomalies show the triangle mark next to the relevant fields wit…
Bank-statement ritagli: storing an excerpt is idempotent — at most one live crop per cash-book movement (same image is reused; a different cut replaces the previous one).
Gestione Controparti: list ordered by number of movements; similar spellings are suggested for aggregation into one canonical name.
Gestione Controparti: merge button reads “Aggrega tutti con …” using the spelling that already has the most movements (the canonical target).
Gestione Controparti: each merge suggestion offers “Mostra questi movimenti” (secondary button) to open every spelling of the group in the movements dialog before aggregating.
